about: Read by tests/tools/run.js. 'failing': suites that fail today for a known reason; the run stays green for them but goes red on any other failure. 'skip': suites that must not run somewhere ('when': 'CI' or 'always'). Every entry carries a reason and a date. Remove an entry the moment its suite passes again (the runner says so).

practice.reason: reads the live database: since the practice password was set (2 Nov) the password screen shows first, so the suite finds no practice bar. Fails on main too. Fix: let the suite get past the password screen.

setup-visual.reason: stale since round 6: it looks for the old 'usual teams' button, which the lineup picker replaced; setup-flow covers the Match tab now. Update it or delete it.
